goal_contract.domain: Existing MGR-P1 synthetic k0 deterministic source; reused four-state L* behavioral model
goal_contract.user_task_input: A binary desired OBSERVATION suffix of length 2, 3 or 4; action alphabet {0,1}; reset raw0; maximum 6 actions
goal_contract.expected_output: Lexicographically earliest minimum-length action sequence of length <=6 whose final observation trace ends with the desired suffix; otherwise UNSAT_WITHIN_HORIZON
goal_contract.goal_definition: For chosen actions a[0..t-1], source emits 1bit after each action; success when t<=6 and output_trace.endsWith(goal)
goal_contract.fixed_benchmark: ALL binary goal suffixes of length 2..4 (4+8+16=28 tasks), no posthoc target selection
goal_contract.semantic_scope: Bounded goal-conditioned control/plan search, NOT general inference, raw-state initialization or novel rule discovery
goal_contract.solver_input: Previously learned four-state model transitions+output+initial ID plus goal suffix+max actions; no source-private phase/noise/step or raw states
goal_contract.independent_gold: Separate raw-source oracle enumerates action strings breadth-first by length and lexical order, returns exact shortest witness or UNSAT_WITHIN_HORIZON
goal_contract.controls: Corrupt learned model transition initial0/action0 and require at least one target with prediction/execution or plan mismatch
goal_contract.nearest_fair_comparator: Independent raw-state exhaustive planning on identical tasks, equality/optimality rather than speed; no cost or inference efficiency claim
goal_contract.refusal_cases: If all nontrivial goals are impossible or all have 0/1-step trivial answers, report inadequate benchmark for original reasoning; if private source is required by solver, mark FAIL
goal_contract.resource_bound: 28 targets × <=127 action words ×6 raw steps; no external model/API
goal_contract.stop_condition: First complete 28-case plus mutation check, no automatic new model or benchmark family

hypothesis: Previously learned future-predictive automaton can be reused to choose actions satisfying unseen user-specified *goal observations* rather than only predict an externally supplied action sequence.
closest_alternative: Model supports prediction only, and cannot pick a correct shortest bounded action sequence; or task is too trivial to say anything about solving a goal.
predicted_pass: All 28 goals independently agree on REACHABLE/UNREACHABLE and exact minimum action length plus lex-first witness; for any chosen plan raw source trace meets goal; corrupted model fails at least one target.
predicted_fail: Any goal output or witness differs from raw source, wrong minimality/UNSAT, solver receives source-private state or mutation passes all targets.
predicted_ambiguous: All positive goals need <=1 action or all goals are UNSAT: benchmark too trivial to support even bounded planning capability; no broad claim.

post_rules.do_not_promote: A finite known model plus BFS solving output suffix tasks is not evidence for open-ended general reasoning; no claim of novel policy learning or cross-task generalization.
